items.title: Orchid Planners, Bharatpur, Chitwan
items.body:
The internship at Orchid Planners in Bharatpur-10, Chitwan, offered valuable practical experience in building and structural engineering. I contributed to architectural and structural drawings, RCC and steel planning, and structural analysis using ETABS, along with reinforcement detailing, quantity estimation, and site investigations.  

Mentorship from experienced engineers enhanced my technical skills and understanding of real-world applications. I also gained proficiency in software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Lumion, D5, ETABS, and Excel, while site visits provided insight into field measurements and construction practices.  

Overall, the internship bridged the gap between theory and practice, strengthening my skills and providing a solid foundation for a career in civil engineering.
